# Codex-generated Module Plan — template guidance only

**Location:** separate implementation repository; generated by Codex **after** owner-approved Final PRD. This Handbook template is guidance, not a prewritten plan.

## PRD coverage and module inventory
Map every V1 requirement to a primary delivery owner and acceptance.

## Module dependency graph and delivery sequence
Explain sequencing, enabling slices, cross-module contracts and constraints.

## Per-module briefs
Name, goal, PRD references, dependencies, acceptance, excluded concerns, risks and readiness gate.

## Release and integration acceptance
Define integration requirements and final product acceptance from Final PRD.

## Approval and change control
Owner confirms plan; trace future module changes to PRD and revision history. No implementation architecture is prechosen here.
